title: Real Character, Campaign, World, Scene & Pixel-Asset Foundation
selected_by_owner: 2026-09-23 owner-approved PCV strict order; PCV-02 selected automatically after verified PCV-01 closeout.

selection_basis.reason: PCV-01 completed the real product spine/persistence/convergence cutover and its approved strict_successor is PCV-02.

objective: A single user can create/open a real campaign/world, create or select a real character, establish ownership/control, prepare a scene, close the app, reopen it, and resume that same governed state. Character visuals are produced by an onboard deterministic pixel-art generator driven by Character Designer parameters and a compact governed primary-art library rather than one-off sprites for every combination.
acceptance: Character creation/sheet/advancement use real repository/persistence boundaries, not fixture adapters.
Campaign membership, world/campaign ownership, scene preparation, first-party content selection and role-safe projections are durable.
Home resumes the active campaign/character/scene in <=2 interactions on phone and desktop.
First-party SMB-08/09 content is consumable as product data, not only golden-test input.
Implement the onboard deterministic pixel-art generator with governed primary parts, semantic palette/mask regions, layer/anchor metadata, offline generation/cache, and Character Designer binding.
Publish the first governed Primary Pixel Asset Pack sufficient for representative person-scale character creation and extension seams for creatures, items and scenes.
boundaries: Preserve the PCV-01 real product shell, durable local-state boundary, packaged Library path, convergence ledger and Asset Demand Ledger.

Use the PCV-01 primary-art dependencies and variation dimensions as the input contract for the onboard deterministic pixel-art generator; do not invent a one-off sprite corpus for every character combination.
Keep character, campaign, world, scene, ownership/control and first-party content on real persistence/repository boundaries rather than fixture adapters.
PCV-03+ remain unauthorized until PCV-02 closes and successor selection occurs.
Do not pull two-device transport/presence/reconnect implementation forward from PCV-03 except for interfaces strictly required to keep PCV-02 boundaries compatible.
Do not activate paid/public/store/commercial provider scope merely to satisfy PCV-02.
next_action: Await owner Continue to govern-start PCV-02. On start, implement the real character/campaign/world/scene persistence path and deterministic onboard pixel-art foundation from the PCV-01 ledgers.

stop_reason.evidence: PCV-01 completed_verified on application merge ab0549b42eac1d6e6c219ad79d4ee0d277ef3c00; PCV-02 selected as its strict successor.
